content.comment_body: Hello, When I look at the hardware code (example: [article_no]), I'm not certain how to determine the hardware type or its version. I need this information so I can choose the correct hardware version in [product_name] Soft. Which hardware version should I select for [article_no]? Where can I find an explanation for these hardware codes? Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users have difficulty determining the correct hardware version for a specific [company_name] [product_name] device when given an article number. They lack straightforward, accessible resources for interpreting hardware codes and selecting the right version in [product_name] Soft software, which leads to uncertainty during configuration or programming.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want easy-to-find information explaining how to decode article numbers to hardware versions and clear guidance on selecting the proper version in [product_name] Soft software.
